Politics · India

Modi, Kejriwal, and CMs address youth amid protests and digital outreach

Prime Minister Narendra Modi conveyed faith in the country's youth following protests, while Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal is focusing on a digital strategy to engage young voters. Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik warned young people about 'external forces' using social media to mislead them. In Jharkhand, Chief Minister Hemant Soren addressed student protests over exam leaks, vowing justice and urging against political affiliations, stating dialogue is preferred over confrontation. International coverage noted South Asia's Gen Z protests and India's PM using Instagram to connect with young voters.
